title: pii_manifest (plaintext before encryption)
description: Decrypted content of the pii_manifest multipart part. Contains real PII in original_value: never log, index or place it in URLs. One entry per redacted occurrence, in document order. Rules the code also enforces but JSON Schema cannot express: entries follow the placeholder order in redacted_md; occurrence_index counts 1, 2, 3... per pii_type; original_value is not whitespace-only and is NFC-normalized.

entries.description: Empty when the document has no PII; the manifest is still delivered.

placeholder.description: Equals [PII_{pii_type}_{occurrence_index}] and appears once in redacted_md. Unique only within one document_id.

original_value.description: Exact source text (NFC) that the placeholder replaced. Sensitive.

redacted_at.description: UTC RFC 3339; equals metadata.created_at. Fractional seconds appear only when non-zero.
